title: Exsude

inlines.v: EXSU'DE, verb transitive [supra.] To discharge the moisture or juices of a living body through the pores; also, to discharge the liquid matter of a plant by incisions. Our forests exude turpentine in the greatest abundance. EXSU'DE, verb intransitive To flow from a living body through the pores or by a natural discharge, as juice.
